Team —

Putting this on your radar and asking for quick review. After the hiring feedback loop and the last two weeks of capacity planning, I’m proposing we transition our Ops Lead (role currently filled by Rory) into a Strategic Programs role focused on Dedicated/Private customer onboarding. The ask here is twofold:

1) Review the attached draft comms to the company + customers (20280602-reorg-comm-draft.md). I tried to keep the public-facing language concise and reassure impacted customers with explicit continuity measures.

2) Approve the handover checklist (handover-checklist.xlsx) and confirm interim coverage for the operational items tied to the QBR deliverables. The QBR slides need a final pass on the org slide to reflect the change.

Why now: the new onboarding priority is blocking a couple of Enterprise pilots (Acme) and the timeline is tight for the July rollouts. We should be explicit about who owns day-to-day SLAs vs. who owns migration workstreams.

Requested timeline: signoff on the comms + coverage plan by EOD Wednesday 6/6 so we can cascade to the wider team and finalize the QBR deck by 6/8.

Key open items I flagged in the draft: handoff owner, escalation path, and a short FAQ for customers.

If you want, I can spin a one-page FAQ for the execs — but I need the factual bits (names/timelines) confirmed first.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference
